title: सम्यक्सम्बुद्ध महाकाव्यका सिद्धार्थको करुणासाधना र अभिप्रेरणा {Compassion and motivation of Siddhartha of the Samyaksambuddha epic}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कवि घनश्याम कँडेलको ‘सम्यक् सम्बुद्ध’ महाकाव्यका प्रमुख चरित्र सिद्धार्थमा निहित करुणाको स्रोत, विकास, उनले गरेको दुःखमुक्ति साधना र अभिप्रेरणा ठम्याउने प्रयास गरिएको छ । यो महाकाव्य कँडेलको गहन अध्ययन, परिपक्व चिन्तन, परिष्कृत लेखन र वृद्ध वयको उच्चतम् उपज हो । यसमा सिद्धार्थको जीवन, उनको त्याग, ध्यानसाधना, ज्ञानप्राप्ति अनि त्यसको विस्तार र प्रचारबारे चर्चा गरिएको भए पनि यस आलेखमा भने उनको करुणास्रोत, साधना र बुद्धत्व प्राप्तिसम्मका घटनाहरूलाई मात्र विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । वर्तमान विश्वका लागि सिद्धार्थको तृष्णमुक्त एबं त्यागपूर्ण  जीवनसाधना, बुद्धत्वप्राप्ति, चिन्तन र दर्शन प्रेरणादायी छ भन्नु यस आलेखको महत्त्व हो । यसको उद्देश्य पनि दुःखको पहिचान कर समनका साथ मानवीय अभिप्रेरणत्मक कार्यबाट वर्तमान स्वार्थी, नैतिकहीन, चरित्रहीन र अविवेकी संसालाई सत्कर्मका साथ सद्धर्ममा लाग्ने प्रेरणा मिलोस् भन्नु हो । बुद्धलाई महाकारुणिक देखाई करुणाको अवलम्बनबाट मेलमिलाप, विश्वप्रेम, विश्वभ्रातृत्व, विश्वबन्धुत्वका साथ विश्वशान्ति सम्भव छ भन्नु यसको निष्कर्ष हो । यो आलेख गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचा र व्याख्यात्मक विधिमा आधारित छ । यसका सन्दर्भहरूलाई एपिएको नेपाली पद्धतिमा राखिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, the compassionate source, development, and efforts at grief relief and motivation connected to the main character Siddhartha of 'Samyaksambuddha', the epic poem by poet Ghanshyam Kandel, are examined. This work involves Kandel's intensive study, mature reflection, refined writing, and the production fitting of advanced age. Even though Siddhartha's life, his sacrifices, meditation, and knowledge acquisition and their expansion and dissemination are discussed, only those events related to his compassionate source, practices and attainment of Buddhahood are analyzed in this article. For the present world, Siddhartha's desire-free and sacrifice-laden life practice, attainment of Buddhahood, reflection and philosophy are deemed significant by this article's objective. Its purpose is also to recognize the suffering and find the chance of humanistic action in the current selfish, immoral, characterless, and heedless world, and its conclusion is that meeting through compassion, world-love, world-brotherhood, and world-peace is possible. This article is based on a qualitative research framework and interpretive method, with references taken in the Nepali method.
british_english: In this present work, the source of compassion, its development, and the attempts at alleviation of sorrow and motivation connected to the principal character Siddhartha of the 'Samyaksambuddha' epic by poet Ghanshyam Kandel are investigated. This entails Kandel's profound study, mature thought, refined writing, and the production befitting advanced years. Although Siddhartha's life, his sacrifices, meditation, and knowledge acquisition and their spread and expansion are discussed, nevertheless only those events relating to his compassionate source, practices and attainment of Buddhhood are analysed in this article. For the contemporary world, Siddhartha's desire-free and sacrifice-filled life of practice, attainment of Buddhhood, reflection and philosophy are held to be significant by the purpose of this article. Its aim is also to identify suffering and find the opportunity for humane action in the present selfish, immoral, characterless, and thoughtless world, and its conclusion is that fellowship, world-love, world-brotherhood and world-peace are possible through compassion's reliance. This article is founded on a qualitative research framework and interpretative method, with references taken in the Nepali manner.
australian_english: This piece looks at the compassionate origin, development, and attempts at easing grief and motivating around the main character Siddhartha of poet Ghanshyam Kandel's 'Samyaksambuddha' epic. It involves Kandel's deep study, mature thinking, polished writing, and the kind of output that comes with age. Even though Siddhartha's life, his sacrifices, meditation, and learning and their growth and spread are covered, only his compassionate source, practices and the path to Buddhahood are analysed in this article. For the modern world, Siddhartha's life without desire and full of sacrifice, achieving Buddhahood, reflection and philosophy are seen as important by this article's objective. Its point is also to recognise suffering and find the chance for human action in the current self-centred, immoral, characterless and uncaring world, and its conclusion is that compassion, world-love, world-brotherhood and world-peace are possible. This article is based on a qualitative research structure and interpretive method, with references handled the Nepali way.

translator_notes: Title contains 'सम्यक्सम्बुद्ध' rendered as 'Samyaksambuddha' per standard Buddhist term. Nepali technical term 'बुद्धत्वप्राप्तिसम्मका घटनाहरूलाई' rendered as 'events related to his compassionate source, practices and attainment of Buddhahood'.
